productDescription: setld is a receipt-verified execution assurance protocol: a job creator escrows a reward on Creditcoin and commits an execution mandate, an executor bonds and performs the transaction on Ethereum, the Attestcoin Protocol proves the real transaction and receipt, and setld pays or penalizes from the committed rules with no human evaluator or centralized oracle.

attestcoin.integrationSummary: SetldCore.settle calls SetldAttestcoinAdapter.verifySingle, which invokes the native BlockProver precompile verify() over the source transaction proof and decodes the same proven bytes (transaction + receipt in one envelope) via the deployed EvmV1Decoder. Every settlement that moves reward or bond value is gated on a proof the Creditcoin verifier accepts; the runtime fails closed (ATTESTCOIN_PROOF_INVALID / SourceBlockNotAttested) and never substitutes an RPC result.

verifiedButWrong.note: Ethereum transaction SUCCEEDED with amountIn 25000 exceeding the committed cap of 10000

replayRejection.note: re-submitting the correct-case proof against a fresh accepted mandate reverts SourceTxAlreadyConsumed

invalid_reward_leakage_setld_T0.note: S9: verified-but-wrong execution refused on-chain, reward refunded

invalid_reward_leakage_baseline_B0_compr.note: S10: compromised reporter asserted FULFILLED for the S9 over-cap execution; B0 paid 10 tSETLD reward. setld refused the identical execution.

public_attestcoin_backed_lifecycles.note: S8 + S9; wider campaign in progress

differential_parity_vectors.note: reference model == Solidity predicate == SetldCore economics

liveTestStatus: testnet — all assets are test assets; tSETLD is a freely-minted mock ERC20
reproductionCommands: pnpm probe:attestcoin   # re-run the S0/S1 environment + field-extraction probe
limitations: One production-quality template (treasury rebalance). Broad 'arbitrary Ethereum task' claims are not made.
CC3<->Sepolia attestation lag was ~1 block/min net during the build; a fresh source transaction takes ~20-30 min to become provable. The live demo uses pre-generated proofs (PRD 28 permits this).
The 100-case deterministic campaign runs on a Foundry fork, not public testnet.
The reporter-compromise ablation uses 2 matched real executions; it demonstrates the mechanism, it is not a large-sample study.
CC3 RPC omits mixHash; CC3 contracts are compiled with evm_version london and deployed via an ethers orchestrator rather than forge script.
